extract: Roger Wayne Marshall is an American politician, physician, and former military officer serving as the junior United States senator from Kansas since 2021. From 2017 to 2021, he was the U.S. representative for Kansas's 1st congressional district, a mostly rural district covering much of western and northern Kansas.
